title: "9-5 JOBS ARE A SCAM, SO IS COLLEGE" - Swag Academy
summary: Debunks 'college and 9-to-5s are scams' guru clips with earnings-by-education and elite-school data on the wealthy; notes the speaker sells a forex course.

assertions.quote: there's more millionaires and billionaires who dropped out of college than those who finished college

verdicts.note: Surveys of the ultra-wealthy show a large majority hold degrees, many from elite schools.

assertions.quote: nine to fives are legitimately the biggest scam ever ran in the universe
if you get a bachelor's degree on average you're gonna make 64k if you get a master's degree on average you just make more

verdicts.note: Bureau of Labor Statistics data show median earnings rising with each education level.

assertions.quote: anybody can pose as a millionaire anyone can pretend to have this empire
do they have any stats to back up their course success stories no they just have a bunch of anecdote testimonial

verdicts.note: DK Automation backed its profit claims with testimonials that did not reflect the experience of any consumer in the FTC's investigation, with disclaimers in unreadably small type; one documented instance.
